sections.Profile:
The Spot-A-Card pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in August 1960, is an electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker. This game features a card and gambling theme, utilizing two flippers, three pop bumpers, four kick-out holes, and a gobble hole.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1960
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Gambling, Card games, Cars
